name: Extrude a profile in a part document

elements.name: extrusion-12 Distance tolerance dialog can be inspected and cancelled

steps.name: Edit Feature with Distance A 8 mm
Tolerance is opened from its dropdown
Model Value is 8.000 mm and Type is Default
Precision, evaluated-size controls, Upper and Lower fields, Hole and Shaft fields are visible
the Type list is opened
it offers Default, Basic, Symmetric, Deviation, Limits-Stacked, Limits-Linear, MAX, MIN, Limits/Fits-Stacked, Limits/Fits-Linear, Limits/Fits-Show Size Limits and Limits/Fits-Show Tolerance
the Type list is dismissed and Cancel is clicked
the extrusion panel remains at Distance A 8 mm

elements.name: extrusion-12 Distance tolerance dialog can be inspected and cancelled

steps.name: the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace
the viewport pointer is idle

elements.name: extrusion-12a Inspect the Distance A editor menu

steps.name: Edit Feature is open for an existing extrusion
the user opens the Distance A editor menu
it offers Measure, Select Feature Dimension, Parameters, Tolerance and List Parameters
the user chooses List Parameters
a list of parameters available in the active part appears
the user dismisses the list and clicks Cancel
the extrusion edit closes without changing the feature

elements.name: extrusion-12a Inspect the Distance A editor menu

steps.name: the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace
the viewport pointer is idle

elements.name: extrusion-12b Select Feature Dimension prompts for a feature

steps.name: Edit Feature is open for an existing extrusion
the user opens the Distance A editor menu and chooses Select Feature Dimension
the status area asks the user to select a feature and then one of its dimensions
the user cancels the extrusion edit
the accepted feature remains unchanged

elements.name: extrusion-12b Select Feature Dimension prompts for a feature

steps.name: the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace
the viewport pointer is idle

elements.name: extrusion-12c Parameters opens the part parameter table

steps.name: Edit Feature is open for an existing extrusion
the user opens the Distance A editor menu and chooses Parameters
a Parameters dialog opens for the active part
the table includes parameter name, consumed-by, unit or type, equation, nominal value, tolerance and model value columns
the user clicks Done
the extrusion panel remains open
the user clicks Cancel
the accepted feature remains unchanged

elements.name: extrusion-12c Parameters opens the part parameter table

steps.name: the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace
the viewport pointer is idle
